title: Angular sanitizer bypassed
description: bypassSecurityTrust* disables Angular's built-in XSS sanitisation for that value. Safe only if the input is genuinely trusted and never attacker-influenced — verify the value's origin. Generalized from legacy-audit patterns (regex_data/NPC-*.md, regex_data/NPG-*.md).

title: document.write with dynamic content
description: document.write injects raw markup into the parser. Any interpolated value that is not HTML-escaped becomes DOM XSS. Generalized from legacy-audit patterns (regex_data/NPC-*.md, regex_data/NPG-*.md).

title: Assignment to outerHTML
description: Assigning to outerHTML parses the string as markup, exactly like innerHTML — an unescaped interpolation is DOM XSS. Use textContent, or sanitise first. Generalized from legacy-audit patterns (regex_data/NPC-*.md, regex_data/NPG-*.md).

title: Non-literal RegExp constructor
description: new RegExp(variable) — ReDoS risk (CWE-185), matches eslint.detect-non-literal-regexp.

title: Auth token stored in browser storage
description: JWT/auth token persisted to localStorage or sessionStorage, which is readable by any JavaScript on the page — vulnerable to theft via XSS. Prefer httpOnly cookies. Framework-agnostic (React/Angular/Vue/vanilla JS/TS).
